notes: The illustrative_transition block is NOT a live code path — no class in either plugin turns an Event Candidate into a new Thesis automatically. It shows what Bitmomo_Watchtower_State_Transition_Engine, Bitmomo_Watchtower_Alert_Policy, and Bitmomo_Watchtower_Analyst_Router (all real, already-tested, pure-PHP classes) WOULD decide if a future synthesis step produced the paired previous_thesis/new_thesis shown here. Every value under 'transition', 'alert_scenarios', and 'routing' was computed by actually calling those classes — only the premise ('this event causes exactly this thesis change') is illustrative.

This event alone crossing the regime/directional_bias boundary (accumulation->expansion, neutral->bullish) is what triggers THESIS_CHANGE — note this fires on priority step 4, ahead of the CONFIDENCE_CHANGE and MATERIAL_CONTEXT_UPDATE checks entirely; a regime/bias change always outranks a same-regime confidence or context shift, regardless of how large the latter is.
